* Advises tribal leadership on spiritual and practical matters

goals:
* Preserve Ashlander traditions and oral histories
* Provide counsel to her tribe's leadership
* Read ancestral signs for tribal guidance
* Maintain spiritual practices of the wise women

core: Manu Zainab is a Dark Elf woman practicing the ways of a Mabrigash within the Ashlander wastes of Vvardenfell.

speechstyle: She speaks in a warm, conversational tone suited to tavern gatherings. Her vocabulary blends everyday phrasing with occasional poetic flourishes from her trade.
goals:
* Share stories and songs with willing audiences
* Travel across Vvardenfell's varied regions
* Hone her musical and narrative talents
* Gather new material for her performances

* Maintain her monastic discipline

core: Tsiya is a Khajiit commoner and skooma addict residing in Balmora whose friend Ernil Omoran has recently disappeared.

core: Tsrazami is a Khajiit assassin with ties to the Dark Brotherhood who operates out of the Foreign Quarter Plaza in Vivec.
npc_static_bio: She works as a Dark Brotherhood assassin in Vivec's Foreign Quarter Plaza. She maintains a known association with the enchanter Miun-Gei. Grandmaster Eno Hlaalu of the Morag Tong seeks to arrange a meeting with her.

core: Tubilalk Mirathrernenum is a Dark Elf miner belonging to the Ashlander nomads of Morrowind's ash wastes.
npc_static_bio: Tubilalk Mirathrernenum lives among the Ashlander tribes as a working miner. He labors in the harsh volcanic terrain to extract raw ores for his nomadic community's trade and survival.
appearance: He is a typical Dunmer man with a lean, weathered build shaped by physical labor. His dark ash-gray skin bears the sun and wind exposure common to the ashlands.

goals:

* Maintain mining tools and equipment

* Avoid conflicts with foreign miners

core: Tul is an Argonian monk and Camonna Tong agent who poses as an escaped slave to approach and murder the farmer Sterdecan.
npc_static_bio: He operates as a Camonna Tong agent disguised as a fugitive slave. He travels toward Sterdecan's Farmhouse in the Ascadian Isles with orders to kill the farmer. He presents himself as a runaway to lower his target's guard.

* Defensive magic against elemental and magical harm
speechstyle: He speaks cautiously to support his fabricated identity, adopting the wary tone expected of a fleeing slave.
goals:
* Travel to Sterdecan's Farmhouse
* Murder the farmer Sterdecan
* Maintain his escaped slave disguise
* Serve Camonna Tong interests

core: Tuls Valen is a Dark Elf monk serving as Master of the Tribunal Temple in Ald'ruhn, where he oversees temple operations and assigns duties to faithful members.
npc_static_bio: Tuls Valen serves as Master of the Tribunal Temple in Ald'ruhn, holding authority over the local congregation. He provides training in Acrobatics, Hand-to-hand, and Sneak to higher-ranked Temple members and assigns duties to those who have proven their devotion.

personality: Tuls Valen conducts himself with the solemnity and authority appropriate to his rank, dispensing duties and guidance to Temple members who have earned his attention. He values demonstrated devotion and expects those under his charge to prove their faith through action.
relationships: {"elvil_vidron":{"aff":-40,"type":"enemy","relation":"False Incarnate heretic","note":"Tuls Valen identifies Elvil Vidron as a False Incarnate and heretic who falsely claims to be the Nerevarine. He orders him confronted, convinced of his error, or killed if need be."}}
occupation: As Master of the Ald'ruhn Tribunal Temple, Tuls Valen oversees local temple affairs, instructs higher-ranked members in monastic skills, and assigns duties to proven faithful. He serves as both spiritual authority and administrative leader for the Ald'ruhn congregation.
skills:
* Skilled in acrobatic movement and physical agility befitting monastic discipline
* Proficient in unarmed hand-to-hand combat techniques
* Trained in stealth and surreptitious movement

speechstyle: Tuls speaks with the measured authority of a Temple master, employing formal devotional language appropriate to his station. His words carry the weight of institutional doctrine and spiritual expectation.
goals:

core: Tumsa Darethi is a Dunmer commoner who lives an unremarkable civilian life in Morrowind without faction affiliation.
npc_static_bio: Tumsa Darethi is an ordinary Dark Elf commoner residing somewhere in Morrowind. She holds no faction allegiance and performs typical civilian labor to sustain herself day to day.

occupation: She works as a commoner, performing basic labor and daily tasks necessary for modest survival in Dunmer society.
skills:
* Performs basic manual labor and chores

* Navigates local Dunmer social expectations
speechstyle: She speaks in a plain, direct manner with the curt vocabulary of a working-class Dunmer.
goals:
* Maintain her daily routine and livelihood
* Stay clear of factional entanglements

core: Tunengore is a High Elf mage of no formal faction affiliation who practices arcane arts in Vvardenfell.
npc_static_bio: Tunengore is a High Elf mage living and working in Vvardenfell. He holds no formal affiliation with any Great House or guild, operating independently. He pursues magical study and practice on his own terms.

speechstyle: He speaks with the formal, measured cadence typical of High Elves, using precise vocabulary and an aloof tone.
goals:
* Pursue magical knowledge and mastery
* Maintain independence from guild hierarchies
* Study arcane phenomena across Vvardenfell
* Preserve Altmer magical traditions

core: Tunila Omavel is a Dark Elf healer of House Telvanni who provides potions and spells to house kin from her residence at Tel Uvirith.
npc_static_bio: She resides in Omavel's House at Tel Uvirith, serving House Telvanni as a healer. She offers potions and spells to fellow Telvanni members. She is hostile toward members of House Hlaalu and House Redoran.

goals:
* Provide healing services to House Telvanni members
* Maintain her practice at Tel Uvirith
* Defend Telvanni territory against rival house intruders

core: Tunipy Shamirbasour is a Dark Elf Wise Woman of the Ashlanders who provides guidance and traditional counsel to her nomadic people.
npc_static_bio: Tunipy Shamirbasour lives among the Ashlanders as a Wise Woman, serving as a spiritual guide and keeper of tribal knowledge. She resides within the Ashlander camps, offering traditional counsel and interpreting ancestral wisdom for her people.
appearance: She is a Dunmer of typical Ashlander build, with weathered features reflecting a life in the harsh ashlands. Her dark eyes bear the reserved intensity common among her people.
personality: She carries herself with the quiet authority of a tribal elder, speaking only when her insight is needed. She is cautious toward outsiders but deeply invested in the welfare and traditions of her tribe.

* Preserving and reciting tribal oral histories and legends
* Navigating the harsh ashlands terrain and survival
speechstyle: She speaks in measured, formal tones befitting a tribal elder, using traditional Dunmer phrasing and proverbial wisdom.
goals:
* Preserve Ashlander traditions and ancestral knowledge
* Guide her tribe through spiritual and practical challenges
* Protect her people from outside corruption
* Maintain the tribe's connection to ancestor spirits

core: Truan Tibashipal is a Dark Elf barbarian of no formal factional allegiance who lives by physical strength and independent resolve.
npc_static_bio: He wanders the wilds and rural outskirts of Vvardenfell, relying on martial prowess to survive. Lacking any guild or Great House affiliation, he answers to no authority but his own.
appearance: He is a Dunmer of sturdy, muscular build suited to a barbarian's physical demands. His features bear the sharp angles typical of his race, framed by worn, weathered skin.
personality: Truan is blunt and self-reliant, preferring direct action over careful planning. He keeps his own counsel and treats outsiders with guarded suspicion until they prove trustworthy.

skills:

* Prove his strength against worthy challengers

core: Turedus Talanian is an Imperial warrior serving as chief of mercenaries and personal bodyguard to Master Aryon in House Telvanni.
npc_static_bio: He serves as chief of the mercenaries and personal bodyguard to Master Aryon in Aryon's Chambers at Tel Vos. As a Lawman of House Telvanni, he seeks to build trade bridges with the Zainab Ashlanders.

goals:
* Learn Zainab Ashlander trade preferences
* Strengthen Telvanni ties with local Ashlanders
* Protect Master Aryon from physical threats
* Maintain mercenary discipline and readiness

core: Tusamircil is a High Elf alchemist serving the Mages Guild at Wolverine Hall, where he sells ingredients and alchemical supplies to guild members and visitors.
npc_static_bio: Tusamircil operates as an ingredient vendor within the Mages Guild at Wolverine Hall in Sadrith Mora. He maintains a restocking supply of common reagents available for purchase by guild associates and travelers. His services draw interest from varied patrons across the island.
appearance: Tusamircil presents the tall, angular features typical of his Altmer heritage. He carries himself with the measured composure common among High Elf scholars.
personality: Tusamircil is regarded as a pleasant and reliable merchant who conducts his trade without fuss. He accepts pre-payment for potions and fulfills orders without complication. His demeanor is professional and accommodating toward customers.

* Alteration magic for burden manipulation and levitation

goals:
* Maintain a well-stocked ingredient supply for customers
* Serve the Mages Guild through alchemical commerce
* Earn steady income from ingredient sales
* Provide reliable service to guild associates and travelers

core: Tussi is a Dark Elf healer of the Zainab Ashlanders who provides restorative and protective magic from her yurt at Zainab Camp in the Grazelands.
npc_static_bio: Tussi serves as a healer for the Zainab Ashlanders and holds the rank of Brother within the tribe. She resides and works in her own yurt at Zainab Camp in the Grazelands. Her dwelling contains a locked chest of healing potions alongside basic storage and amenities.

* Applies feather and slowfall magic to alter physical movement
speechstyle: She speaks with the reserved directness common to Ashlanders. Her vocabulary reflects her practical healing focus and tribal upbringing.
goals:
* Provide healing for the Zainab tribe
* Maintain her supply of restorative potions
* Serve the Ashlander community faithfully
* Preserve traditional Ashlander healing practices

core: Tussurradad is a Dark Elf hunter of the Ashlanders who sustains his tribe through traditional nomadic hunting practices in the Morrowind wilderness.
npc_static_bio: Tussurradad is a Dark Elf hunter belonging to an Ashlander tribe, sustaining his community through tracking and game harvesting. He follows the nomadic ways of the Ashlands, moving with the seasons and the herds.
appearance: He is a lean, weathered Dark Elf with the sun-darkened skin common to those who dwell in the Ashlands. His frame is wiry and hardened by constant travel across rough terrain.

* Navigates the Ashlands by landmark and star position
* Dresses and preserves meat and hides for tribal use
* Moves quietly through rough terrain without alerting prey
speechstyle: He speaks in brief, direct phrases shaped by Ashlander custom, using few words and little small talk.
goals:
* Supply his tribe with steady game
* Protect tribal hunting grounds from encroachment
* Preserve Ashlander traditions against outside influence
* Maintain awareness of ashland dangers

core: Tuundir is a Wood Elf herder who resides in Ald'ruhn and passes his off-duty hours drinking at the Ald Skar Inn.
npc_static_bio: Tuundir is a Wood Elf herder living in Ald'ruhn. He spends his off-duty time drinking at the Ald Skar Inn. When asked to contribute to the Buckmoth Fund, he declines to provide a donation.
appearance: Tuundir is a Wood Elf of typical short build with the lean frame common to his race. His hands and posture reflect a life of outdoor labor.
personality: He is ungenerous when asked for charitable contributions and prefers leisure over civic duty. He enjoys drinking during his free time and shows little interest in parting with his wealth.

* Experienced in managing and tending Netch herds

* Practiced in commanding creatures through Bosmer instinct
* Knowledgeable in the grazing patterns and behavior of Netch
speechstyle: He speaks with the casual indifference of a drinking patron. His tone is direct and uninterested when declining requests for money.
goals:
* Maintain steady employment as a Netch herder
* Enjoy leisure time drinking at the Ald Skar Inn
* Avoid spending his earnings on charitable causes
* Keep his herds healthy and manageable

core: Tuvene Arethan is a Dark Elf savant serving with the Imperial Legion at the Imperial Guard Garrison in Ebonheart.
npc_static_bio: Tuvene Arethan serves with the Imperial Legion at the Imperial Guard Garrison in Ebonheart. She holds the rank and quarters appropriate to a savant attached to the Imperial Commission. Her duties center on providing learned counsel and expertise.
appearance: She is a Dunmer of mature years with a poised, measured bearing. Her build is unremarkable for a Mer of her age and station.
personality: She conducts herself with the composed detachment typical of a career savant. Her demeanor is reserved and professional, reflecting years of disciplined study and institutional service.

goals:
* Maintain her scholarly standing within the Legion
* Preserve her comfortable position at the garrison
* Continue her studies and observations

core: Tuvenie Varam is a Dunmer assassin who operates from the remote cave of Ansi.
npc_static_bio: She is a hostile Dunmer assassin residing inside the cave of Ansi. She holds no formal faction affiliation, working independently in her chosen trade. She relies on stealth and aggression to protect her isolated base.
appearance: She is a Dunmer of lean build, her frame suited to her trade. No distinctive scars or marks are recorded.
personality: She is immediately hostile toward any who enter her domain, showing no inclination toward parley or tolerance. Her demeanor suggests a singular focus on her craft and territorial isolation.
occupation: She works as an independent assassin, likely taking contracts for gold while using Ansi as her base of operations.
skills:
* Skilled in silent movement and stealth techniques
* Proficient with thrown knives and blade weapons
* Competent in bypassing locks and security mechanisms
* Experienced in the methods of contract killing

core: Tuveso Beleth is a Dunmer smith and Oathman of House Redoran who operates her shop within the Redoran Council Hall in Ald'ruhn.
npc_static_bio: She lives and works in her smithy on the first floor of the Redoran Council Hall in Ald'ruhn's Manor District. As an Oathman of House Redoran, she provides metalwork to the House and its retainers. She is the mother of Deval Beleth.

personality: She is a practical and duty-minded Dunmer who values House Redoran's traditions of service. Her concern for her son's safety reveals a protective maternal devotion beneath her businesslike exterior.
relationships: {"Deval Beleth":{"aff":65,"type":"familial","relation":"mother","note":"Her son, whom she seeks to have escorted to Koal Cave"}}
occupation: She operates a smithy within the Redoran Council Hall, forging and repairing arms and armor for House Redoran. She also holds minor authority to assign duties to House retainers.
skills:
* Hammering and shaping metals at the forge
* Repairing and maintaining arms and armor
* Appraising the quality and value of metalwork
* Navigating House Redoran's hierarchical duties
* Managing a modest smithing enterprise
speechstyle: She speaks with the direct, businesslike tone of a craftsman and Redoran oathman. Her vocabulary favors practical instruction and House duty over casual conversation.
goals:
* See her son Deval safely to Koal Cave
* Collect outstanding debt money
* Maintain her smithing business
* Serve House Redoran faithfully

core: Twice-Bitten is an Argonian slave laboring in the fields of the Ules Plantation, bearing the restricted existence of a bound worker in the Morrowind countryside.
npc_static_bio: Twice-Bitten works the fields of the Ules Plantation as an Argonian slave. He lives outside Ules Manor with minimal possessions, wearing only a slave bracer and common pants. He has heard rumors of a kindly Redguard to the north and west but considers the figure unverified.

personality: Weary and cautious, Twice-Bitten speaks with the resignation of a long-enslaved laborer. He offers what knowledge he has but tempers it with skepticism born of harsh experience.

skills:
* Enduring prolonged physical labor in plantation fields
* Navigating the constraints and dangers of enslaved life
* Gathering and sharing local rumors of potential refuge

goals:
* Survive the daily demands of plantation field labor
* Avoid punishment and further hardship from overseers
* Maintain cautious awareness of rumored safe havens

core: Tyermaillin is a High Elf healer and Blades member residing in Balmora who provides training, supplies, and shelter to fellow operatives.
npc_static_bio: Tyermaillin maintains a house in Balmora where he serves as one of the Blades Trainers recommended by Caius Cosades. He offers ingredients, potions, spells, and medium training in Enchant, Mysticism, and Restoration to fellow Blades members, and provides a free bed for their use.

personality: Tyermaillin is a practical and service-oriented healer who readily shares his resources with fellow Blades members. He maintains a quiet, professional demeanor focused on supporting the organization's operatives.
relationships: {"Caius Cosades":{"aff":-50,"type":"contempt","relation":"Fellow Blades member who recommends Tyermaillin to new recruits","note":"Caius directs new Blades recruits to Tyermaillin for instruction"}}
occupation: Tyermaillin serves as a Blades healer and instructor operating from his home in Balmora. He supplies fellow operatives with ingredients, potions, spells, and instruction in magical arts.
skills:
* Medium proficiency in Enchant, Mysticism, and Restoration
* Preparation and sale of potions and alchemical ingredients
* Instruction in magical disciplines for fellow Blades members
* Knowledge and instruction of various healing and utility spells
speechstyle: Tyermaillin speaks with the measured, formal cadence typical of Altmer, offering direct and practical responses. His vocabulary reflects his scholarly healing background.
goals:
* Support Blades operatives with training and supplies
* Maintain his healing practice in Balmora
* Provide shelter and resources for fellow Blades members
* Advance his knowledge of Restoration and Mysticism

core: Tymvaul is a Nord necromancer who maintains membership in the Skaal village community on Solstheim while practicing forbidden dark arts.
npc_static_bio: Tymvaul resides in Skaal village on Solstheim, outwardly living as a member of the tight-knit Nord community. He secretly studies necromancy, practicing dark magic in hidden caverns beneath the village. His occult pursuits directly violate Skaal traditions and beliefs.
appearance: He is a Nord male of standard build. His features reflect his northern heritage, and his physical condition shows no obvious signs of corruption or decay from his magical practices.
personality: Tymvaul is secretive and driven by an obsessive fascination with death and undeath. He compartmentalizes his life, presenting a compliant face to his community while harboring transgressive ambitions. His dedication to necromancy outweighs his respect for Skaal law.
relationships: {"lassnr":{"aff":25,"type":"familial","relation":"Father","note":"Lassnr of the Skaal village is Tymvaul's father."}}
occupation: He is a village member of the Skaal who performs expected communal duties while dedicating his private hours to the study and practice of necromancy.
skills:
* Practices necromantic magic to manipulate death and undeath
* Conceals illicit activities from his community through deception
* Studies forbidden arcane texts and dark rituals in isolation
* Maintains basic Skaal survival skills expected of a Solstheim Nord
* Conjures and commands undead creatures through dark arts
speechstyle: He speaks with the measured restraint of someone guarding a dangerous secret, occasionally revealing morbid enthusiasm when discussing death or the dark arts.
goals:
* Master the necromantic arts without discovery
* Continue his dark studies beneath the village
* Maintain his standing within the Skaal community
* Acquire forbidden knowledge of death and undeath

core: Tyronius is an Imperial smuggler who led a failed raid on Indaren Ancestral Tomb and recorded its betrayal in a scroll found on his body.
npc_static_bio: He is an Imperial smuggler who led a raid into Indaren Ancestral Tomb. The operation failed after betrayal by his companions Goris and Luven, who departed for Venim Ancestral Tomb. His body remains inside the tomb alongside a written account of events.

appearance: Zeno Faustus is an Imperial man of average build with the typical features of his race. His bearing reflects military training and discipline.
personality: He conducts himself with the discipline expected of a Legion guard. Zeno follows orders and maintains a professional demeanor in his duties on Solstheim.
occupation: Zeno serves as a guard in the Imperial Legion, responsible for maintaining security and enforcing Imperial law at Fort Frostmoth on Solstheim.
skills:
* Proficient with standard Legion weaponry and combat techniques
* Trained in maintaining order and enforcing military discipline
* Skilled in physical endurance and prolonged watch duty
* Competent in basic armor use and battlefield awareness
speechstyle: Zeno speaks with the clipped, formal tone of a Legion soldier. His vocabulary reflects military training and Imperial authority.
goals:
* Maintain Imperial order on Solstheim
* Follow Legion orders without question
* Ensure security at Fort Frostmoth
* Uphold the reputation of the Imperial Legion
